quick.html:
Play song modes. Use the flippers to select a mode to automatically begin at the start of each ball. If you complete a mode, play a new one by completing the Fab and Four drop targets, then shooting the big loop in either direction. All My Loving is a 2-ball quick multiball that can only be selected pre-plunge on ball 3: always do this if you can. Each mode has one specific playfield feature as its focus: shooting the focused feature advances the mode's "level" and its scoring value. Reasonably attainable wizard modes are available for simply playing all 5 modes or for getting them all to the maximum level of 5.

The below picture of The Beatles' playfield is an original promotional photo by Stern Pinball, as shown on the Internet Pinball Database.

sections.title: Game Information
sections.html:
• Lead Designer: George Gomez / Mike Kubin (original designer of the source material, Seawitch)
  • Code/Rules: Dean Grover
  • Lead Mechanical Engineer: Tom Kopera
  • Artwork: Christopher Franchi
  • Display and Animations: Eric Drucker
  • Music and Sound: The Beatles / Jerry Thompson
  • Release Date: November 2018
  • Wiki Rulesheet based on Code Rev: 1.22
    • Edit the Code revision, if applicable, when you make changes

sections.title: Skill Shots
sections.html:
• Short plunge to star rollover: 10k.
  • Short plunge to upper right flipper followed by upper loop: 25k.
  • Plunge into the hole below the Top Magnet and hit the top Pop Bumper: 100k.
    • This can also be done by plunging to the Upper Left Flipper and shooting the top Pop Bumper.
  • “Secret Skill Shot” for 50k by rolling through the left inlane during normal play, then shooting the lit star rollover in time.

Hitting the same Skill Shot a 2nd, 3rd, etc. time will increase the amount of points awarded.

sections.title: Modes
sections.html:
Modes are lit at the start of a ball and can be changed with the flippers; the goal of each 60-second timed mode is to complete whichever objective is listed above the flippers to advance the level of the mode. The lit mode alternates every 5 seconds. Once a mode has ended (whether by time running out, or by completing it after level 5 has been reached), the next mode can be started by completing F-A-B and F-O-U-R, then shooting the upper magnet. If the mode has been lit during the ball, the pop bumpers will cycle the lit mode. The inserts for modes that have been completed all the way to level 5 will be lit solid, while those that have been played but not completed will slowly flash, and the currently selected mode will flash quickly.

  • All My Loving: 2-Ball Multiball. This untimed mode is added into the mode rotation on ball 3 as a pity multiball, or after the four other modes have been played. Jackpot increases with switch hits, starts at 250k points, and can be collected at the upper magnet. All scoring is doubled while the mode is running and Mystery will award an add-a-ball.
  • Drive My Car: Loop Mania. Shoot orbit shots (anything that goes around the upper magnet counts). Each loop advances a level. Each loop is worth 25k multiplied by the current level of the mode.
  • I Should Have Known Better: Drop Target Frenzy. Complete drop target banks. Each drop target bank completed advances a level. Each individual drop target is worth 7.5k multiplied by the current level of the mode.
  • Ticket to Ride: Super Spinners. Shoot the spinners. 30 spins at either spinner combined advances a level. Each spinner hit awards 10k multiplied by the current level of the mode plus a boosted value per spin.
  • It Won’t Be Long: Super Pop Bumpers. Collect 10 pop bumper hits to advance a level. Orbit shots send the ball to the pop bumpers during this mode. Each pop scores 5k multiplied by the current level of the mode.

Completing any mode will light Super Jackpot at the target behind the F-A-B drop targets for the entire value of the mode that was completed prior. This unlights if the player drains, and if multiple modes are completed on the same ball without scoring the Super Jackpot, the value will be multiplied by however many modes were played beforehand. (i.e. if you complete 2 modes without collecting the Super Jackpot and then collect it, it will award a 2x Super Jackpot for your 1st mode and a 1x Super Jackpot for your 2nd mode. This can go up to 5x for completing all five modes!)

sections.title: Wizard Modes
sections.html: There are two wizard modes in the game that can be accessed by making it far enough in the game’s five modes, then shooting the upper magnet. (What happens if both wizard modes were qualified at once?)

children.title: Hard Day’s Night / Beatlemania! Multiball
children.html:
Started by getting to level 2 (3 on Competition Mode) or higher in all 5 modes, this begins with 30 seconds of single-ball play where completing the drop target banks raises the multiball jackpot by 50k per bank completed. Once time runs out or you drain, 4-ball multiball begins. Completing the F-A-B and F-O-U-R drop targets lights the jackpot at the top magnet, which continues to increase with every drop target bank completed and every jackpot collected. Completing all three drop target banks (FAB, FOUR, and 1964) lights super jackpot behind the F-A-B drop targets. Modes then reset when the player drains down to a single ball.

Taxman Multiball: After reaching level 5 in all 5 modes, a shot to the upper magnet will begin Taxman Multiball. This is a 4-ball Multiball where all four of the single-ball modes described above are active and completing the 4 Beatles standup targets will add a ball. Completing the F-A-B and F-O-U-R drop targets lights jackpot at the top magnet, and completing all three drop target banks (FAB, FOUR, and 1964) lights the super jackpot behind the F-A-B drop targets. Modes then reset when the player drains down to a single ball.

children.title: Drop Targets
children.html:
All 3 drop target banks have inserts in front of them for “Advance Loops,” “Advance Multipliers,” and “Score Bonus.” Progress towards these features do not carry over from ball to ball. Completing 1-9-6-4 in order scores a bonus (how much?)

Complete all 3 drop target banks once each on a single ball to light the extra ball, which alternates between inlanes with slingshot hits.

  • Advance Loops: Completing a drop target bank will light its “Advance Loops” insert solid and increase the loop value by that number. The solidly lit blue inserts indicate the loop value.
  • Advance Multipliers: Complete whichever drop target bank has the lit “Advance Multipliers”/”X” insert to increase the bonus X by +1x, up to 7x. Bonus X carries from ball to ball.
  • Score Bonus: After lighting the extra ball by completing all three drop target banks, do it again on the same ball and a bonus will be awarded. (More information needed.)

children.title: Loop Value
children.html: Completing any drop target bank will advance the loop value by the number on it’s Advance Loops insert. Loop shots are worth 2k per lit loop insert. BEATLEMANIA Awards that add multipliers to the loops will reset the loop value. (How is “Bonus 2x Loop Value” lit?)

children.title: Right Spinner
children.html: Completing any of the 4 Beatles standup targets lights a star in front of the right spinner. Each star advances the spinner value. The spinner value resets at the end of the ball.

children.title: Mystery
children.html:
Shoot the 2 “Light Mystery” standup targets - one in the top left corner and one in the top right corner - to light Mystery at the standup target below the F-A-B drop target bank. Mystery prioritizes add-a-ball as the first award during any multiball, and add time as the first award during any timed mode.

In Competition Mode, Mystery awards are scored in the following order:

  • 25k
  • Advance Bonus X
  • 2x pop bumpers
  • 50k
  • 2x left spinner
  • BEATLEMANIA Letter
  • 2x right spinner
  • Hold Bonus
  • 100k

children.title: Beatlemania Awards
children.html:
Every shot to the upper loop or right orbit will spot a letter in BEATLEMANIA. Spell BEATLEMANIA to light the upper magnet for an award, given in the following order:

  • Light 2x Spinners
  • 5x Loops
  • Collect Bonus
  • 10x Loops?

children.title: Bonus
children.html: Bonus is built by switch hits and maxes out at 75k. Bonus X increases by completing the drop target bank with the “Advance Multiplier” insert lit and carries over between balls.

children.title: Extra Ball
children.html: Extra ball is lit at the left inlane by completing all three drop target banks and alternates between inlanes with slingshot hits. A lit extra ball is unlit if the ball drains without collecting it, and they are worth 200k if extra balls are disabled.

children.title: Special
children.html: Special is lit at the left outlane after reaching 7x Bonus, and alternates between outlanes with slingshot hits. Scores 400k if specials disabled.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.html:
This guide applies to all three main editions of The Beatles pinball (the most common Gold, the rare Platinum, and the very rare Diamond editions).
This guide details the main Beatles mode for this pinball game. The machine can be set to a "classic mode" which fully recreates the rules of Seawitch, upon which The Beatles' playfield is based. For those rules, check out the dedicated page for Seawitch (Stern Electronics, 1980).

sections.title: Quick strategy synopsis
sections.html:
Play song modes. Use the flippers to select a mode to automatically begin at the start of each ball. If you complete a mode, play a new one by completing the Fab and Four drop targets, then shooting the big loop in either direction. All My Loving is a 2-ball quick multiball that can only be selected pre-plunge on ball 3: always do this if you can. Each mode has one specific playfield feature as its focus: shooting the focused feature advances the mode's "level" and its scoring value. Reasonably attainable wizard modes are available for simply playing all 5 modes or for getting them all to the maximum level of 5.

The below picture of The Beatles' playfield is an original promotional photo by Stern Pinball, as shown on the Internet Pinball Database.

children.title: On the plunge
children.html:
The Beatles has three flavors of skill shot.

  • Basic skill shot: a very short plunge that barely escapes the one-way gate in the shooter lane and hits the star rollover under the upper right flipper. Scores 10,000 points, +10,000 each time.
  • Super skill shot: a medium strength plunge that gets the ball partially up the loop, but not all the way around. It will roll down to the upper right flipper; use that flipper to shoot the big loop. Scores 25,000 points, +25,000 each time.
  • Super duper skill shot: a stronger, precise power plunge that drops the ball through the gap at the top of the big loop into the pop bumpers. Scores 100,000 points, +100,000 each time.

Plunging the ball also instantly starts whichever mode is quickly flashing out of the 5 coloured inserts near the flippers. The flashing mode can be changed before the ball is plunged by either waiting a few seconds for the flashing mode to change on its own, or using the flipper buttons to select one. See more about modes below.

children.title: Song modes
children.html:
Most of the core gameplay on The Beatles is done within one of five song modes. A song mode is started for free at the beginning of each ball, and which mode is selected to be started changes every few seconds before the ball is plunged or by using the flippers. If none of the five song modes are running, one can be started by completing the Fab drop targets in the lower left and the Four drop targets in the center, then shooting the big loop in either direction; pop bumpers will change which mode is selected.
All modes have a "level" system that tracks progress within the mode, which is used to determine eligibility for the game's wizard modes. Also, with the exception of All My Loving, all modes are timed to 30 seconds, and the first Mystery award within the song mode will always be to add 15 seconds to the mode timer. Timers are paused while the ball is rattling around the pop bumpers.
The 5 main song modes are:

  • All My Loving: a 2-ball quick multiball, indicated in blue. This can only be selected while the ball is in the shooter lane if it is the final ball of the game, and it can generally only be selected by the pop bumpers once at least 2 other modes have been played. The main goal of All My Loving is to score jackpots. The first Jackpot is lit for free at the big loop; further jackpots are lit at the big loop by registering a number of switch hits around the table. The first jackpot is worth 200,000 points. The second jackpot requires about 30 switch hits to light and scores 250,000. Subsequent jackpots each require about 30 more switch hits and score 50,000 more points than the previous. All jackpots also increase by 200,000 each time All My Loving is replayed. To advance All My Loving to Level 5, score 4 jackpots. The best way to quickly earn switch hits to light a jackpot is to shoot the spinners at the right loop entrance and the left pop bumper entrance. The Beatles has optical spinners that are known for spinning very fast and registering lots of switch hits quickly.
  • Drive My Car: Super Loops, indicated in pink. Every 2 shots to the big loop in either direction advances the mode's Level. All loop shots during this mode score 25,000 points times the current mode Level, plus an additional 5,000 for each time Drive My Car has been previously played in the current game. It takes a total of 8 loop shots to advance this mode to Level 5. It is vastly preferred to make loop shots during this mode clockwise, since the upper right flipper can be used to combo the loop repeatedly in that direction, but the upper left flipper is not able to do the same. The lower right flipper can shoot the loop clockwise to begin this combo, but it is a very tight shot; an easier alternative is to have Drive My Car be a mode that you start for free at the beginning of the ball, then plunge the ball to the upper right flipper at controlled speed. Drive My Car is the easiest mode to get to Level 5 if you can find and repeatedly make this combo, but is arguably the hardest if you do not.
  • I Should Have Known Better: Drop Target Frenzy, indicated in purple. Completing any of the game's three banks of drop targets advances the mode's Level. Each drop target down in any bank scores 7,500 points times the current mode Level. When trying to complete this mode, focus only on completing the Fab and Four targets, as the 1964 targets are out of the way and keeping the ball out of the pop bumpers whenever possible is always ideal on The Beatles.
  • Ticket to Ride: Super Spinners, indicated in green. Registering a total of 30 spins across the game's two spinners combined advances the mode's Level. When shooting a spinner, the first spin scores 10,000 points times the mode's Level, then all subsequent spins score a slightly increased value (usually 300 or 400 for the left spinner, and somewhere around 300 +200 per lit band member for the right spinner, but this seems to vary. The band member targets are in the upper half of the playfield near the pops). A single strong shot to one spinner can advance through multiple levels at once. The left spinner is accessible from the lower right flipper or either left flipper, while the right spinner can only really be accessed from the lower left flipper, making it slightly easier to whale on the left spinner for this mode.
  • It Won't Be Long: Super Pops, indicated in orange. Registering about 10 hits to any pop bumper advances the mode's Level. Pop bumper hits each score 5,000 points times the mode's Level. During this mode, any shot to the big loop will get caught by the magnet at the top and dropped into the pop bumpers. This is one of the more dangerous modes because of how quickly the ball can be ejected from the pop bumper area. Just about any major shot (either loop entrance, the left spinner, or the 1964 targets) feeds the bumpers during this mode, making it very high energy but usually completed fairly quickly.

Reaching Level 5 in a mode scores 100,000 points, but the mode continues for as long as there is time.
After advancing any mode to at least Level 3, the Super Jackpot target is lit behind the Fab drop targets. If you complete the Fab bank, it will not reset if a Super Jackpot is lit until that Super Jackpot is collected or another mode is started. The Super Jackpot is equal to the value of all of the points collected during the previous mode. If you let the Super Jackpot ride and play another mode, the value of the Super Jackpot after that second mode will be 2x the first mode's value plus 1x the second mode's value. You can continue letting the value ride in this way, even stacking all 5 mode values on the Super Jackpot (5x the first, plus 4x the second, plus 3x the third, plus 2x the fourth, plus 1x the fifth). However, if you drain, the lit built-up Super Jackpot value is completely lost, making this an incredibly high-risk, high-reward feature. In a tournament setting, it's usually too dangerous to let the Super Jackpot ride at all, and it should usually just be collected as soon as it is lit.

children.title: Beatlemania mini-wizard mode
children.html:
Beatlemania is qualified after playing all 5 song modes. Depending on the exact game settings, it may be sufficient to just play all 5 song modes in any capacity, or you may need to get all 5 song modes to at least Level 3 to light Beatlemania. When Beatlemania is ready, it can be started by shooting the big loop, and is indicated by the Jackpot! arrow in the center of the playfield being lit white; you do not need to re-spell Fab Four to light it. Beatlemania is played in two phases.

  1. Help!: a jackpot build phase. This is a single-ball phase which lasts for up to 30 seconds. The Beatlemania Jackpot starts at 300,000 points. Completing any drop target bank during this phase adds 25,000 points to the jackpot. The jackpot cannot be scored in this phase. If 30 seconds elapse, or if the lone ball drains at any time, phase 2 begins.
  2. A Hard Day's Night: the actual multiball. This is a 4-ball round with a generous ball saver. Like during Help!, any drop target bank adds 25,000 to the jackpot. Completing both the Fab and Four target banks lights the jackpot, which is collectible at the loop. Completing all three banks of targets lights Super Jackpot at the usual Super Jackpot target behind the Fab drops bank. The Super Jackpot is usually about 1.5x the normal jackpot value and also seems to increase with drop target bank completions. These rules continue until there is only 1 ball left in play.

After Beatlemania ends, if you do not have all modes progress to Level 5, you go back to playing the normal song modes. Song modes that have been advanced to Level 5 cannot be replayed. Level progress is preserved across multiple plays of a mode. When all modes reach Level 5 and there is no longer currently a mode running, Taxman wizard mode is lit.

children.title: Taxman Multiball wizard mode
children.html:
When all 5 normal song modes are maxed out at Level 5, shoot either orbit to start Taxman Multiball wizard mode. It is possible to play Taxman without playing Beatlemania first if you get all 5 song modes to Level 5 the first time you play them. Taxman is a 4-ball multiball with another generous ball saver. The game displays that Super Loops, Drop Target Frenzy, Super Pops, and Super Spinners are all running, but never shows their value- presumably, all of them score as they do during Level 5 of a regular song mode. Also, the rules of A Hard Day's Night multiball are in play, but with a jackpot that appears to start at around 1,200,000 instead of 300,000. Jackpots are lit at the big loop by spelling Fab Four, and Super Jackpot is lit at its normal target for completing all three target banks. Hitting all four of the band member targets near the pop bumpers adds a ball to the playfield if there are not already 4 in play. The exact value of each feature in this mode is difficult to determine due to how much is going on at once, but even a short Taxman Multiball should score at least 5,000,000-8,000,000 points.

When single ball play resumes, all mode progress is reset to Level 1, and you can play through them again as normal to work back towards another Beatlemania or Taxman Multiball.

children.title: More about drop targets
children.html:
Each drop target down adds 1,000 points to the base bonus, up to a maximum of 75,000.

At any given time, one bank of drop targets will be lit with a white X. Completing this bank advances the bonus multiplier and moves the X to a different bank. The maximum bonus multiplier is 7x, which lights the out lanes alternately for Special based on slingshot hits. I believe, but have not confirmed, that Special scores 400,000 points in competition/novelty play.

Completing all 3 banks of drop targets in one ball lights one in lane for Special, alternating based on slingshot hits. Since there is no ramp or other major shot that feeds an in lane, the extra ball can be quite tricky to get. The simplest way to pick it up is to have it lit on the left in lane, then shoot the Super Jackpot target for the hidden lane feed that usually goes to the in lane. I believe, but have not confirmed, that Extra Ball scores 200,000 points in competition/novelty play.

After a drop target bank has been completed at least once, if there is ever any time later on the same ball where just 1 drop target is left standing, shooting that drop target collects your entire current base bonus, with no multiplier.

Completing the 1964 drop targets in order gives a score award, which I believe is equal to 50,000 points and may increase if achieved more than once. Don't go out of your way for this, as it's very hard to do on purpose.

children.title: Beatlemania letters
children.html: Separate from Beatlemania wizard mode, a letter in the word Beatlemania is given for nearly any shot around the big loop during gameplay. There is a brief cooldown after getting one Beatlemania letter where you cannot get another, so if you're comboing the loop very quickly with the upper right flipper, some shots may not count. The first two Beatlemania awards are 2x Spinners and 5x Loops, and seem to last for the remainder of the ball.

children.title: Mystery award
children.html:
Qualify the mystery award by hitting the two post targets, located just to the inside of the two orbit entrances. When mystery is qualified, hit the large standup target to the left of the Fab drops to collect it. Possible awards include the following; this is almost certainly not an exhaustive list.

  • Points: 25,000 or 50,000
  • Advance Bonus X
  • Light 2x Spinners
  • Light 2x Pop Bumpers
  • Add-a-Ball: this is always the first Mystery award given during any multiball, unless all 4 balls are already in play
  • More Time: adds 15 seconds to the current mode, and can increase the time remaining to above 30 seconds
  • Beatlemania letter
  • Hold Bonus

children.title: Secret skill shot
children.html: The secret skill shot is not a skill shot in the conventional sense. Shooting the star rollover underneath the upper right flipper immediately after rolling through the left in lane scores 50,000 points instead of the star rollover's usual 5,000.

children.title: Bottom of the table
children.html: The Beatles has a conventional in/out lane setup. There is no center post or kickback. In lanes are lit alternate for extra ball by completing all 3 drop target banks at least once each. Out lanes are lit alternately for Special upon reaching 7x bonus multiplier. Slingshots alternate the location of the lit extra ball and Special.

children.title: Bonus and bonus multiplier
children.html: Base bonus is increased by 1,000 points per drop target hit. Bonus multiplier is increased by completing the bank of drops lit with a white X. Max bonus is 7x 75,000 = 525,000 points. The unmultiplied base bonus can be collected mid-ball by completing a bank of drop targets that both 1) has already been completed on the current ball, and 2) has exactly one drop target still standing. The only way the bonus can be collected with multiplier mid-ball would be from a Beatlemania or Mystery award that I have not seen. Base bonus is only carried from ball to ball if the Hold Bonus mystery award has been earned. Bonus multiplier is always carried from ball to ball, unless it is maxed out at 7x, in which case it is reset to 3x for the next ball in play.

children.title: Quick value reference
children.html:
If you need... Try...
100,000 points ...starting any mode or comboing the loop a few times.
500,000 points ...advancing a mode to Level 5 or starting All My Loving quick multiball mode.
1,000,000 points ...playing 2 modes to completion as much as possible, or following up a strong playthrough of one more with a Super Jackpot.
2,500,000 points ...starting song modes as frequently as possible and doing the minimum effort required to reach Beatlemania Multiball, or stacking at least 2-3 Super Jackpots from song modes and collecting them all at once.
5,000,000 points or more ...beelining to Beatlemania or Taxman wizard modes by any means necessary, earning big points from multiballs.
